svg.title: The lab model retains 12 KiB of logical KV per token
svg.desc: Qwen2.5-0.5B has24layers,2KVheads and64values per head. At2bytes/value, keys and values require2×24×2×64×2=12288bytes per retained token. Four hypothetical2048token sequences require96MiB logical payload. Device allocation includes many other components.

g.text: K,V layers KV heads head width bytes/value
No measured concurrency or total-VRAM claim follows from this sum.
